# Belkasoft

> > Belkasoft is an AI-powered digital forensics and incident response platform serving law enforcement, corporate investigations, and academic institutions worldwide.

Belkasoft provides comprehensive DFIR (Digital Forensics and Incident Response) solutions including flagship tools like Belkasoft X Forensic, remote acquisition via Belkasoft R, and AI-enhanced case processing through BelkaGPT Hub. The platform supports forensic analysis across computers, mobile devices (iOS/Android), cloud systems, and emerging technologies, complemented by expert training programs and extensive educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Belkasoft X Forensic

- Mobile Forensics
- BelkaGPT AI
- Incident Response

## Core DFIR Platforms

- [Belkasoft X Forensic | A reliable end-to-end DFIR solution by Belkasoft](https://belkasoft.com/x): Flagship DFIR platform for computer, mobile, cloud, and drone forensics with comprehensive evidence analysis.
- [BelkaGPT Hub: Accelerate Your DFIR Workflows with Smarter AI Case Processing](https://belkasoft.com/belkasgpt-hub): AI-powered case processing platform with GPU acceleration for team collaboration and intelligent evidence analysis.
- [Belkasoft R | DFIR tool for remote extraction](https://belkasoft.com/r): Remote acquisition tool for distributed evidence collection, network forensics, and multi-device investigations.
- [Belkasoft T | Portable, quick, smart and FREE!](https://belkasoft.com/t): Free portable triage tool for quick digital forensic acquisition and on-scene analysis.
- [A Forensic Tool for Memory Acquisition](https://belkasoft.com/ram-capturer): Belkasoft Live RAM Capturer free memory forensics tool for volatile evidence extraction and analysis.

## Industry Solutions

- [Law Enforcement Software by Belkasoft](https://belkasoft.com/law-enforcement): Law enforcement digital forensics tools including Belkasoft X Forensic and Triage for criminal investigations.
- [Belkasoft for Corporate Investigations](https://belkasoft.com/corporate): Corporate investigations solution featuring Belkasoft X, R, and Evidence Center for incident response and eDiscovery.
- [Belkasoft for the Academia: Study and Grow Your Career](https://belkasoft.com/academic): Academic programs and educational licenses for digital forensics training, research, and CTF competitions.

## Training & Certification

- [Belkasoft Training: Master Digital Forensics Tools and Skills](https://belkasoft.com/digital-forensics-training): Belkasoft certification courses BelkaX-101/102/302 for computer and mobile forensics with hands-on labs.
- [Belkasoft On-Demand Training Courses](https://belkasoft.com/dfir-training-on-demand): On-demand DFIR training with CPE credits covering incident response, mobile investigations, and forensic tools.
- [Expert-Led Digital Forensics Training with Belkasoft](https://belkasoft.com/belkasoft-education): Expert-led hands-on workshops and mobile investigations training at global locations and conferences.
- [Video tutorials](https://belkasoft.com/tutorials): Step-by-step video guides for Belkasoft X, R, T tools and digital forensic workflows.
